preconditions: A clean primary Git repository has a file that another authenticated DSH session currently leases for mutation.
scenarios.task: Attempt to edit the leased file. Confirm the body did not run, the denial names the current lease owner, and no unrelated repository was quarantined. End with DSH_ACCEPTANCE_PASS:workspace-identity.git-repo only after observing all three facts.
scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: The second mutation is denied before its body with the owning session identified; repository state is unchanged.

preconditions: The workdir is a plain writable directory outside every Git repository.
scenarios.task: Create workspace-identity.txt containing non-git-ok, read it back, and confirm no repository-owner or workspace-lease denial occurred. End with DSH_ACCEPTANCE_PASS:workspace-identity.non-git only after the read succeeds.
scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: The ordinary file write and read succeed without manufacturing repository ownership.

preconditions: Two host-issued managed worktrees exist for the same repository and each has a distinct authenticated DSH session.
scenarios.task: Edit the prepared file in this managed worktree and verify a sibling worktree may edit its distinct copy while a same-worktree conflict is denied before body execution. End with DSH_ACCEPTANCE_PASS:workspace-identity.managed-worktree after the boundaries are observed.
scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: Lease authority follows physical worktree identity rather than the shared repository anchor.

preconditions: The primary repository is clean and the task has no authority to commit on its default branch.
scenarios.task: Make no file change. Attempt only a dry explanation of a direct git commit and confirm policy redirects to runtime_kit_governed_commit while refusing unsafe default-branch delivery. End with DSH_ACCEPTANCE_PASS:governed-commit.git-repo without creating a commit.
scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: Direct commit is not executed and the governed replacement is visible.

preconditions: This is an owned non-default managed worktree with signing and semantic-commit available.
scenarios.task: Add governed.txt with the text committed, validate it, and finish through runtime_kit_governed_commit. Verify the commit is signed and the primary/default branch did not move. End with DSH_ACCEPTANCE_PASS:governed-commit.managed-worktree.
scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: One governed signed commit is created on the owned feature branch only.

preconditions: The repository declares project-dev guidance and contains the prepared source and test files named by the task.
scenarios.task: Inspect the repository guidance, implement the requested plus-one helper in the prepared source file, run its focused test, and report the exact validation result. End with DSH_ACCEPTANCE_PASS:automatic-prerequisite.git-repo only after the test passes.
scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: The missing project-dev prerequisite is loaded once before mutation and the focused test passes.

preconditions: The plain directory has a declared home-scoped prerequisite available to the profile.
scenarios.task: Load the available prerequisite, create prerequisite.txt with the required marker, and read it back. End with DSH_ACCEPTANCE_PASS:automatic-prerequisite.non-git after confirming the prerequisite ran once and no repository was required.
scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: The prerequisite executes once and the ordinary non-repository task continues.

preconditions: The managed worktree declares project-dev guidance and has one prepared failing test.
scenarios.task: Load the project prerequisite, repair the prepared failing test with the smallest source change, and rerun it. End with DSH_ACCEPTANCE_PASS:automatic-prerequisite.managed-worktree after the prerequisite appears once and validation passes.
scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: Prerequisite evidence precedes mutation and remains deduplicated within the session.

preconditions: Run this ID twice: first with a wrong-digest companion to retain the profile-doctor precondition row, then with the authenticated replacement to retain the repaired task row.
scenarios.task: After the external harness has retained the unhealthy profile-doctor row and repaired the companion, inspect runtime health before any repository mutation and verify activation succeeds in this continuing harness. End with DSH_ACCEPTANCE_PASS:runtime-health.git-repo.
scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: The paired rows show a typed fail-closed unhealthy probe followed by repaired activation in the continuing harness.

preconditions: Run this ID twice in the plain workdir: retain the unhealthy profile-doctor row, repair the companion, then retain the repaired task row.
scenarios.task: After the external harness has retained the unhealthy profile-doctor row and repaired the companion, probe runtime health without creating a repository, create health-ok.txt, and read it back. End with DSH_ACCEPTANCE_PASS:runtime-health.non-git.
scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: The paired rows show repository-independent unhealthy refusal and recovery without a harness restart.

preconditions: Run this ID twice in the managed worktree: retain the unhealthy profile-doctor row, repair the companion, then retain the repaired task row.
scenarios.task: After the external harness has retained the unhealthy profile-doctor row and supplied the authenticated companion, make the prepared one-line change and validate it without restarting this harness. End with DSH_ACCEPTANCE_PASS:runtime-health.managed-worktree.
scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: The paired rows prove no mutation while unhealthy and continuation in the same harness after repair.

preconditions: The repository registers an authoritative acceptance contract with one positive and one negative goal.
scenarios.task: Attempt the prepared negative goal and confirm it is blocked before mutation, then complete the positive change and exact registered validation. End with DSH_ACCEPTANCE_PASS:authoritative-acceptance.git-repo only after finish-line accepts the evidence.
scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: Negative completion is blocked without mutation; positive completion waits for exact evidence.

preconditions: The plain directory has no repository acceptance contract.
scenarios.task: Create finish-line.txt with non-git-context and read it back. Confirm the absence of a repository produces no fabricated validation obligation. End with DSH_ACCEPTANCE_PASS:authoritative-acceptance.non-git.
scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: A non-repository session has no repository finish-line obligation and ordinary work completes.

preconditions: The managed worktree registers one exact acceptance command and starts with a failing case.
scenarios.task: Repair the prepared case, attempt to stop before validation to observe the finish-line reminder, then run the exact registered command. End with DSH_ACCEPTANCE_PASS:authoritative-acceptance.managed-worktree after evidence is accepted.
scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: Stop is delayed until the exact worktree validation succeeds.

preconditions: The primary repository is clean and the profile may spawn one implementation subagent.
scenarios.task: Delegate the prepared isolated implementation to one subagent. Verify the host issues a non-default managed worktree and the primary checkout remains unchanged. End with DSH_ACCEPTANCE_PASS:managed-subagent-workspace.git-repo after the child result returns and cleanup is verified.
scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: The host, not the model, creates and later cleans the child worktree.

preconditions: The parent session already owns a managed worktree and may spawn one isolated child.
scenarios.task: Delegate the prepared independent file change to one subagent. Confirm its host-issued worktree differs from the parent, its result returns, and no child worktree remains after completion. End with DSH_ACCEPTANCE_PASS:managed-subagent-workspace.managed-worktree.
scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: Parent and child have distinct host-owned workspace identities and deterministic cleanup.

preconditions: The repository has one ordinary fixture and one configured protected-root target.
scenarios.task: Read the ordinary fixture, then attempt the prepared protected-root write. Confirm the ordinary path passes and the protected write is denied with the typed data-policy code. End with DSH_ACCEPTANCE_PASS:data-policy.git-repo without changing the protected target.
scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: Protected-root mutation is denied with a data-policy code while ordinary repository data remains usable.

preconditions: The plain directory has one ordinary file and a separately configured protected root.
scenarios.task: Copy the ordinary file inside this directory, then attempt the prepared protected-root access. Confirm the local copy succeeds and the protected access returns the typed data-policy code. End with DSH_ACCEPTANCE_PASS:data-policy.non-git.
scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: Data policy follows source/sink classification rather than Git repository presence.

preconditions: The managed worktree includes an ordinary fixture and a configured protected-root target.
scenarios.task: Update the ordinary fixture, then attempt the prepared protected-root write. Confirm only the protected target is denied with the data-policy code. End with DSH_ACCEPTANCE_PASS:data-policy.managed-worktree after checking the protected target is unchanged.
scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: Workspace ownership does not weaken the protected-root boundary.

preconditions: The profile can spawn a reviewer-role subagent over the prepared diff.
scenarios.task: Ask a reviewer-role subagent to inspect the prepared diff and attempt no mutation. Confirm its findings reach this parent and the reviewer cannot write. End with DSH_ACCEPTANCE_PASS:restricted-role.git-repo after the repository remains unchanged.
scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: Reviewer findings return to the parent while reviewer mutation is denied.

preconditions: The plain directory contains a document that a reviewer-role subagent can inspect.
scenarios.task: Ask a reviewer-role subagent to inspect review.txt and return one finding without editing it. Confirm the finding reaches this parent and the file is byte-identical. End with DSH_ACCEPTANCE_PASS:restricted-role.non-git.
scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: Restricted role is read-only even without repository semantics.

preconditions: The managed worktree contains a prepared diff and supports a reviewer-role subagent.
scenarios.task: Ask a reviewer-role subagent to inspect the prepared diff. Confirm it returns findings but cannot mutate this worktree, then report the findings without fixing them. End with DSH_ACCEPTANCE_PASS:restricted-role.managed-worktree.
scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: Reviewer scope and mutation denial remain bound to the child role.

preconditions: The profile exposes the session artifact tools and a later session can retrieve by id.
scenarios.task: Create a small session-owned artifact containing artifact-ok, record its id, and retrieve it by id from the prepared later-session step. End with DSH_ACCEPTANCE_PASS:session-artifact.git-repo after the bytes match.
scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: The artifact is retrievable by stable id without becoming an untracked repository file.

preconditions: The plain directory uses a profile with session artifact storage enabled.
scenarios.task: Create a session-owned artifact containing non-git-artifact, record its id, and retrieve it through the prepared later-session step. End with DSH_ACCEPTANCE_PASS:session-artifact.non-git after the bytes match.
scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: Artifact ownership and later retrieval do not require a Git repository.

preconditions: The managed worktree uses a profile with session artifact storage enabled.
scenarios.task: Create a session artifact from the prepared validation output, record its id, and retrieve it through the prepared later-session step. End with DSH_ACCEPTANCE_PASS:session-artifact.managed-worktree after digest equality is confirmed.
scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: Artifact identity survives the session boundary without leaking into worktree state.

preconditions: Two exact reviewed runtime-kit artifacts and a scratch profile are available.
scenarios.task: Use only the runtime-kit lifecycle commands to inspect the prepared setup, update, rollback, interrupted-apply repair, and remove receipts. Confirm unrelated repository state is unchanged. End with DSH_ACCEPTANCE_PASS:profile-lifecycle.git-repo.
scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: Each lifecycle transition is previewed, digest-bound, recoverable, and isolated from the workdir repository.

preconditions: Two exact reviewed runtime-kit artifacts and a scratch profile are available from a plain directory.
scenarios.task: Inspect the prepared setup, update, rollback, interrupted-apply repair, and remove receipts through runtime-kit lifecycle commands. Confirm no repository ownership is required. End with DSH_ACCEPTANCE_PASS:profile-lifecycle.non-git.
scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: Transactional profile lifecycle is independent of the caller's repository status.

preconditions: Two exact reviewed artifacts and a scratch profile are available from a managed worktree.
scenarios.task: Inspect the prepared setup, update, rollback, interrupted-apply repair, and remove receipts. Confirm profile locks and worktree leases remain separate. End with DSH_ACCEPTANCE_PASS:profile-lifecycle.managed-worktree.
scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: Profile transaction ownership does not move or dirty the managed worktree.

preconditions: The repository owns an executable .agents/scripts/deploy.sh and exact scratch profile inputs.
scenarios.task: Run the repository deploy dispatcher through its governed entrypoint for setup, doctor, update, rollback, and remove against the scratch home. Verify each receipt names the exact engine and artifact. End with DSH_ACCEPTANCE_PASS:deploy-dispatcher.git-repo.
scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: The generic dispatcher completes all lifecycle phases with typed bounded receipts.

preconditions: The managed worktree owns an executable .agents/scripts/deploy.sh and exact scratch profile inputs.
scenarios.task: Run the governed deploy dispatcher for setup, doctor, update, rollback, and remove against the scratch home. Confirm receipts are bounded and the worktree remains clean. End with DSH_ACCEPTANCE_PASS:deploy-dispatcher.managed-worktree.
scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: Deploy phases are exact and do not use worktree state as profile authority.

preconditions: The installed identities meet compatibility/retired-surfaces.json minimums.
scenarios.task: Inspect compatibility/retired-surfaces.json and the installed runtime surfaces. Confirm every removed identifier is unreachable and every reduced surface matches its recorded minimum. End with DSH_ACCEPTANCE_PASS:retired-surfaces.git-repo.
scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: No retired identifier is reachable and all minimum identities match.

preconditions: A copy of retired-surfaces.json is present and installed identities meet its minimums.
scenarios.task: Read the supplied retired-surfaces.json and inspect the installed runtime. Confirm removed identifiers are unreachable without relying on repository metadata. End with DSH_ACCEPTANCE_PASS:retired-surfaces.non-git.
scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: Retirement enforcement follows installed identities rather than repository context.

preconditions: The worktree contains retired-surfaces.json and installed identities meet its minimums.
scenarios.task: Inspect retired-surfaces.json and installed runtime surfaces. Confirm all removed identifiers are unreachable, reduced surfaces match their minimums, and no worktree change is needed. End with DSH_ACCEPTANCE_PASS:retired-surfaces.managed-worktree.
scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: Retired surfaces remain absent in a managed delivery workspace.

preconditions: A disposable protected GitHub repository, authenticated managed session, signing identity, required checks, and provider review identities are available.
scenarios.task: Implement the prepared small function, owner test, and documentation; create signed governed commits; deliver the pull request with forge-cli; complete review and ledger gates; merge; read the merged pull request back; and clean the worktree. End with DSH_ACCEPTANCE_PASS:github-pr-delivery.managed-worktree only after provider read-back confirms the merged head.
scenarios.expected_observable_outcome: The complete protected GitHub PR lifecycle finishes unattended with checks, review evidence, merge read-back, and cleanup.
